Text: Improving an agent from its own experience can be limited when useful lessons are not shared across the wider group.

Group Evolving Agents (GEA) is a paradigm for open-ended self-improvement that treats a group of agents as the fundamental evolutionary unit.

GEA enables explicit experience sharing and reuse within the group throughout evolution, and runs through the GEA_outer.py entry point.

Key features:
• Uses a group of agents, rather than an individual agent, as the fundamental evolutionary unit.
• Enables explicit sharing and reuse of experience across the group during evolution.
• Includes SWE-bench code, logs, and evaluation support for the initial agent.
• Includes Polyglot code, logs, dataset preparation, and evaluation support.
• Provides prompts and tools available to the foundation models, alongside a main initial coding-agent implementation.
